website.publicationContentStatus: Detailed release notes present; public pins and actual date follow publication.

recentChatChecks: Two saved recent chats without an observer; DB bytes unchanged; legacy zero user-event flags do not hide real chats
Committed WAL data readable while writer stays open
Durable shortcuts retained when index disappears
localValidation.avatarRefresh: Equal IPC avatar identities do not trigger another canvas draw; idle avatars are paused; only the working dot can pulse.

idleVisualCheck.scope: Synthetic Chromium fixture: after initial fabric-texture warmup, idle strip PNG bytes identical across 2.5 seconds and snapshot refreshes; not a native compositor/FPS benchmark.

limitations: Recent shortcuts show up to two non-archived saved chats per account, not a claim that both are open. Fewer saved chats produce fewer shortcuts.
Temporary/unsupported index errors preserve saved shortcuts with an availability notice; a first use without any readable index cannot invent chats.
Live activity/attention depends on connected managed clients; recent shortcut presence is independent.
VSCode tracks editor windows; ambiguous CLI terminal navigation refuses rather than targeting the wrong window.
Windows Orbit unsupported; Windows launcher/editor/updater regression coverage passed.
macOS27 unavailable; macOS26 results do not establish27 behavior. Mac bundles ad-hoc signed, no DeveloperID/notarization.

No final native Hyprland/GNOME/KDE geometry retest for this patch. Prior release tests do not establish final-package geometry coverage. Mixed monitors/scaling/X11/accessibility/long soak remain outside this completed matrix.
Installed launcher Update-button test not performed; native SDK fixture results do not substitute for it. Current real clients and credentials untouched.

validationHistory.reason: Initial native recent-index check returned no chats. Additional inert metadata diagnostics required.
Confirmed real saved app-server conversations have has_user_event=0. Removed this unreliable filter; a regression covers the native case.
Superseded before publication by the corrected recent-index filter. No old package reused.
